title: Classic Sloppy Joes
description: A simple saucy ground-beef sandwich for nights when dinner needs to require almost no thought.

steps.text: Brown the meat and optional onion; drain excess fat.
Stir in sauce, brown sugar, mustard, and Worcestershire. Simmer until thick.
Spoon onto buns.

cookSteps.text:
BROWN IN SKILLET:
{{q0}} ground beef or turkey
{{q1}} diced onion (optional)

Break up the meat and cook until no pink remains; drain excess fat.

STIR IN:
{{q2}} tomato sauce
{{q3}} brown sugar
{{q4}} yellow mustard
{{q5}} Worcestershire sauce

Simmer until saucy and slightly thickened.

SPOON ONTO:
{{q6}} hamburger buns

Serve hot.

title: Black Bean & Cheddar Quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas filled with seasoned black beans and melted cheddar.

ingredients.item: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Mash beans lightly with taco seasoning.
Fill tortillas with beans and cheese, fold, and toast in a skillet until crisp and melted.

cookSteps.text:
MASH LIGHTLY:
{{q1}} black beans
{{q3}} taco seasoning

FILL:
{{q0}} tortillas
{{q1}} seasoned beans
{{q2}} shredded cheddar

Fold tortillas in half.

HEAT SKILLET WITH:
{{q4}} butter or oil

Cook quesadillas until crisp and golden; flip halfway through.

storage: Refrigerate cooked quesadillas up to 3 days; reheat in a skillet.

title: Tomato Bacon Grilled Cheese
description: A familiar grilled cheese made dinner-worthy with tomato and crisp bacon.

steps.text: Layer cheese, bacon, and tomato between bread; butter outsides.
Cook over medium-low until golden and cheese melts.

cookSteps.text:
ASSEMBLE:
{{q0}} bread
{{q1}} cheese
{{q2}} cooked bacon
{{q3}} sliced tomato

Butter the outside with {{q4}} softened butter.

COOK OVER MEDIUM-LOW.

Toast until the first side is golden.
FLIP AND COOK until the second side is golden and the cheese is melted.

storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: Classic Tuna Melts
description: Creamy tuna salad under hot melted cheddar on toasted bread.

steps.text: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and mustard.
Divide over bread, top with cheese, and bake until hot and melted.

cookSteps.text:
MIX:
{{q0}} drained tuna
{{q1}} mayonnaise
{{q2}} yellow mustard

TOP:
{{q3}} bread slices

Divide tuna mixture over bread and add {{q4}} cheddar cheese.
BAKE AT 400°F until hot and the cheese is melted and lightly browned.

storage: Refrigerate tuna mixture up to 3 days; assemble melts when ready to eat.

title: Easy Meatball Subs
description: Frozen meatballs, jarred marinara, and mozzarella tucked into warm sub rolls.

steps.text: Heat meatballs in marinara until piping hot.
Fill rolls, top with mozzarella, and bake briefly until melted.

cookSteps.text:
SIMMER:
{{q0}} frozen cooked meatballs
{{q1}} marinara sauce

Cover and heat until the meatballs are hot through.

FILL:
{{q2}} sub rolls

Add hot meatballs and sauce; top with {{q3}} mozzarella. Bake at 425°F until melted.

storage: Refrigerate meatballs and sauce up to 4 days; assemble subs fresh.

title: Loaded Baked Potatoes for Dinner
description: Microwave-baked potatoes piled with broccoli, cheddar, and sour cream for an easy full meal.

steps.text: Pierce potatoes and microwave until tender.
Heat broccoli, split potatoes, and load with broccoli, cheddar, sour cream, and optional butter.

cookSteps.text:
PIERCE AND MICROWAVE:
{{q0}} russet potatoes

Turn halfway through and cook until easily pierced with a fork.

MICROWAVE:
{{q1}} frozen broccoli

Heat until tender and hot.

SPLIT POTATOES AND TOP WITH:
{{q1}} broccoli
{{q2}} cheddar
{{q3}} sour cream
{{q4}} butter (optional)

storage: Refrigerate cooked potatoes up to 4 days.

title: Sheet-Pan Bean & Cheese Nachos
description: A sheet pan of crisp tortilla chips, black beans, corn, and melted cheese that doubles as a very easy dinner.

ingredients.item: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Spread chips on a sheet pan and top with beans, corn, and cheese.
Bake until cheese melts; serve with salsa.

cookSteps.text:
SPREAD ON SHEET PAN:
{{q0}} tortilla chips

Top evenly with {{q1}} black beans, {{q2}} corn, and {{q3}} shredded cheese.
BAKE AT 400°F until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Serve with {{q4}} salsa if desired.

storage: Best fresh. Refrigerate leftover toppings separately when possible.

title: English Muffin Pizzas
description: Crisp English muffin halves with pizza sauce, mozzarella, and easy toppings.

ingredients.item: sliced pepperoni or diced cooked vegetables

steps.text: Top muffin halves with sauce, cheese, and optional toppings.
Bake until crisp and bubbly.

cookSteps.text:
TOP:
{{q0}} split English muffins
{{q1}} pizza sauce
{{q2}} mozzarella
{{q3}} pepperoni or cooked vegetables (optional)
BAKE AT 425°F until the edges are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

storage: Refrigerate cooked pizzas up to 3 days; reheat in oven or air fryer.

title: Quick Cheesy Ravioli Bake
description: Refrigerated ravioli baked under marinara and mozzarella for lasagna energy with almost no assembly.

steps.text: Layer ravioli, marinara, and mozzarella in a baking dish.
Bake covered until hot, then uncover briefly to brown the cheese.

cookSteps.text:
LAYER IN BAKING DISH:
{{q0}} cheese ravioli
{{q1}} marinara sauce
{{q2}} mozzarella
{{q3}} Parmesan (optional)

Cover with foil.
BAKE COVERED AT 400°F until hot and bubbling.
UNCOVER AND BAKE until the cheese is lightly browned.

title: Sheet-Pan Sausage, Peppers & Onions
description: Smoky sausage roasted with bell peppers and onion; eat it as-is or tuck it into rolls.

steps.text: Toss sausage, peppers, and onion with oil and seasoning.
Roast until vegetables are tender and browned. Serve alone or in rolls.

cookSteps.text:
TOSS ON SHEET PAN:
{{q0}} sliced smoked sausage
{{q1}} sliced bell peppers
{{q2}} sliced onion
{{q3}} olive oil
{{q4}} Italian seasoning
ROAST AT 425°F until vegetables are tender and browned, stirring once halfway through.

SERVE AS-IS OR TUCK INTO:
{{q5}} sub rolls (optional)
